candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner check require with require(true) so non-owner callers can also send ether, changing who can successfully invoke sendTo
Replace the receiver non-zero require with require(true) so sending to address(0) succeeds instead of reverting, changing behavior for zero-address calls
Replace the amount > 0 require with require(true) so zero-amount transfers succeed instead of reverting, changing behavior for zero-amount calls
Delete the owner check require so anyone can call sendTo, changing which callers succeed
Delete the receiver non-zero require so calls to address(0) succeed, changing observable behavior for zero-address receiver
Delete the amount > 0 require so zero-amount calls succeed instead of reverting, changing behavior for zero-amount calls

Replace the transfer call with a call to selfdestruct(payable(receiver)) (assuming the contract holds no ether, this changes observable behavior by destroying the contract instead of transferring ether)
